karte.prompt: Paint this exact map as a soft watercolour landscape map of the land of Israel in the first century, seen from above. Keep every coastline, lake and river EXACTLY where they are in the attached template (same shapes, same positions, same scale) – the template is a precise map and will be overlaid with place names later. Water as pale blue-grey washes; the land in sand and pale olive washes, a few soft hill shadows in Galilee and the Judean hills, the deep Jordan valley a little darker. No place names, no lettering, no symbols, no roads, no compass, no border, no frame. Very reduced, loose watercolour sketch on warm white paper, like a quick painted study: few thin broken ink lines, flat transparent pale washes that bleed softly, lots of untouched paper, no shading detail, no texture, no lettering. Small muted palette: sand, ochre, terracotta, blue-grey, olive, soft ink grey.
